title: Recorded exact-target operator decision
description: Immutable audit acknowledgement of one operator decision over one observed exact delivery target. The record never stages a send, never creates a delivery generation, and never mutates the observed outbox row: resumption goes only through the normal outbox claim and attempt fences. Observation fingerprints and categories are evidence only; the storage transaction revalidated the full observed state before this record was committed.

action.description: What was decided. Both actions are audit-only acknowledgements over one unstarted scheduled row; the vocabulary is frozen across the specification page, the Python model, the storage CHECK constraint, and this enum.

observed_generation.description: Persisted finalized attempt counter at decision time, including zero for never-dispatched work.

observed_status.description: Revalidated outbox status at decision time; only unstarted scheduled rows are decidable, so the value is always one of these tokens.

observed_updated_at.description: Persisted update version the decision CAS-guarded.
